# ClearPath

> Free, open-source browser extension that makes any website accessible — simplifies text, reads pages aloud with word highlighting, and overlays AAC symbols. No account required.

ClearPath is built for AAC users, people with dyslexia, and anyone who needs web content on their own terms. It works on top of any existing website — no cooperation from the site owner required.

## Key facts

- Price: free, no account required, no data collected
- Platforms: Chrome and Chromium browsers (Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera); Manifest V3. Not in the Chrome Web Store yet, so it currently installs from source. Firefox support is planned after Chrome.
- License: open source, MIT
- Privacy: no servers, no analytics. Reading Mode, Focus Tools, Symbol Overlay, and Vocabulary work offline, and Read Aloud does with the computer's built-in voices. Simplify requires your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, or a local Ollama instance); the key stays on the device where it was entered and is never synced or exported.

## Features

- **Read Aloud** — text-to-speech with word-by-word highlighting, built into every page. Configurable voice, speed, pitch. Works offline with the computer's built-in voices.
- **Simplify** — right-click any text and rewrite it in plain English at Grade 3, 5, or 8 reading level. Requires your own LLM API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, or local Ollama).
- **Reading Mode** — strips pages down to their content, applies OpenDyslexic font, adjustable spacing and column width, four color themes (Light, Dark, Sepia, High Contrast).
- **Focus Tools** — a reading ruler that follows the cursor (any page), plus paragraph focus and word-complexity highlighting with simpler alternatives (inside Reading Mode).
- **Symbol Overlay** — displays AAC pictogram symbols above words using the open ARASAAC library.
- **Profiles** — save named accessibility configurations and export/import them as JSON (never includes the API key), useful for SLPs and caregivers configuring a device for someone else.
- **Vocabulary** — double-click any word for an instant plain-English definition, powered by a bundled offline dictionary (21,000+ entries). No API key, no internet required.

## Brand

- Logo: the "C-path mark", a C that starts at a ringed dot and opens onto a forward chevron, in a blue-to-mint gradient. Use the files from the brand guide rather than redrawing it.
- Colors: navy #0D1F3C (background), blue #5B9BF8, mint #6DD9A8; gradient #5B9BF8 → #6DD9A8.
- Type: DM Serif Display for headings, DM Sans for body text, JetBrains Mono for code.
- Name: "ClearPath", one word, capital C and P.
